g1.label: 1. Why "Big Sky Country"?
g1.why: The blogger explains Montana is called ‘Big Sky Country’ because of its enormous sky.

g2.label: 2. How many glaciers today?
g2.why: The text says Glacier National Park has 25 glaciers left today.

g3.label: 3. What did Jim say about the valley?
g3.why: The retired cowboy Jim told the blogger the valley looks different now.

g4.label: 4. What will the blogger visit in Missoula?
g4.why: The text says the blogger plans to visit a bookshop in Missoula.

g5.label: 5. What is essential for getting around?
g5.why: The travel guide says a car is essential for getting around Montana.

g6.label: 6. Why visit in early September?
g6.why: The guide recommends early September because it is quieter then.

g7.label: 7. Why strict campfire rules?
g7.why: The text says Montana has strict campfire rules because of wildfires.

g8.label: 8. The blog's style is...?
g8.why: The text says the travel blog is written in a personal style.

g1.label: 1. We decided to ___ early
g1.why: ‘Set off’ is the phrasal verb for beginning a journey.

g2.label: 2. We finally ___ at the hotel
g2.why: ‘Check in’ is the fixed phrase for registering at a hotel.

g3.label: 3. Don't miss the chance to ___ the views
g3.why: ‘Take in’ means to look at and enjoy a view.

g4.label: 4. The best way to ___ Montana
g4.why: ‘Get around’ means to travel or move about a place.

g5.label: 5. We were lucky to ___ a waterfall
g5.why: ‘Come across’ means to find something by chance.

g6.label: 6. I tried to ___ the atmosphere
g6.why: ‘Capture’ means to record something, like an atmosphere, in writing or on camera.

g7.label: 7. We want to ___ every day
g7.why: ‘Make the most of’ means to use time as fully as possible.

g8.label: 8. We decided to ___ the national park
g8.why: ‘Head to’ means to travel towards a destination.

g1.label: 1. The last wild places in the ___ US
g1.why: ‘Contiguous’ describes the connected lower 48 states, as the text defines.

g3.label: 3. The landscapes are truly ___
g3.why: ‘Stunning’ describes landscapes that are extremely beautiful.

g4.label: 4. Many areas are extremely ___
g4.why: ‘Remote’ describes areas far from other people.

g6.label: 6. The distances are ___
g6.why: ‘Vast’ describes very large distances between towns.

g7.label: 7. The summer crowds have ___ out
g7.why: ‘Thinned out’ describes crowds becoming fewer by September.

g8.label: 8. Check local fire ___
g8.why: ‘Regulations’ are official rules, here about lighting campfires.
